title: Surfacing with Luke M de Zilva

rows.title: Here You Come Again
notes: 1977 RCA Records Label Nashville

rows.title: Bentur
notes: “This is Lintang Raditia Lentaman Bandur from Aftermaps to the Noise in the Indonesia compilation.”
Track 2 on 'Aftermaths 2: The Noise in Indonesia' (Groove Cafe, 2019); ASR heard the compilation subtitle as 'Aftermaps to the Noise'.

rows.title: Saturn Beeja (Root) Mantra - "Om Hlim Sham Shanaye Namaha"
notes: 2023 DhyaanaGraha

rows.title: Dentuman Kode Bentur
notes: “starting from the top is lintang raditia dentaman kod bentur”
Same track as entry 1, re-announced ('dentaman kod bentur' is another ASR pass at 'dan Teman - Bentur').

rows.title: Cakup Lima
notes: “in the middle we had i wayan arek wirawan wichakup lima”
Track 22 on the same Indonesian noise compilation; 'Wicaksana Lima' was ASR mishearing 'Cakup Lima'.

rows.title: Susu Kembang
notes: “that last one puto eman sabudi zumbandi eman susu kembang”
Closing track (30) on the compilation, matches title and artist closely.

rows.title: Skeptis
notes: “let's listen to Skeptis from Myth”
Track 15 on the compilation, exact title/artist match.

rows.title: Phenobarbital
notes: “saint lucifer with feno barbatal which was just yeah the incredible opener from the compilation”
Opening track (1) of the compilation; 'Saint Lucifer / Feno Barbatal' is ASR garble of 'Stylucipher / Phenobarbital'.

rows.title: Explorasi No. 4
notes: “we also listened to tracks from uh Kambang Charaqui at the top with exploration number four”
Track 13 on the compilation, title translates directly to 'Exploration No. 4'.

rows.title: Lolongan Hutan
notes: “you heard it from you know the artist Theo Nugraha with Lolongan Hutan which essentially translates to the howl of the forest”
Track 29 on the compilation, exact title/artist match ('howl of the forest').

rows.title: Kedai Sahabat
notes: “we also listened to tracks from one and bench lab the kadai sahabat which you just listened to”
Track 6 on the compilation; 'One And Bench Lab' is ASR mishearing 'WAHN X BENCH LAB'.

rows.title: medium-mov(1)
notes: “we're gonna get back into the music and this one is called jamonja medium move one”
Track 9 on the compilation; 'Jamonja Medium Move' is ASR garble of artist Jarnejar's track 'medium-mov(1)'.

rows.title: Sea Anomaly
notes: “Ai Putu Gere Sukarayan Balot with Sea Anomaly.”
Track 11 on the compilation; 'Sea Anomaly' is a phonetic reading of 'C (Anomali)'. Balot has two tracks on this comp — the other is 'Selendro (Anomali)'.
